title: Rabbi Tanchum of Parod
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: [Avodah Zarah 31a](https://www.sefaria.org/Avodah_Zarah.31a.3) relates that Rabbi Yochanan came to Parod and said, “Is there any teaching of Bar Kappara here?” Rabbi Tanchum of Parod recited one to him. Hyman infers from the passage that he was Bar Kappara’s student.[^1]

notes.text: The linked Gemara has Rabbi Yochanan ask for a teaching of Bar Kappara and Rabbi Tanchum of Parod recite it. See [Heilprin’s entry on Rabbi Tanchum](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=3580&lang=en). Hyman infers that Tanchum was Bar Kappara’s student.
